title: Wonderful Towels!
text: Wonderful Towels!. I had low expectations for these microfiber towels. I've had several microfiber beach and bath towels over the years and they have been just okay. These towels are a bit more plush and thicker than what I have used in the past. Usually they are super thin and have a kind of weird feeling when you dry off with it. These are nothing like that. I am very impressed and very happy with them!

product_metadata.title: OLESTER Microfiber Bath Towels 4 Colors for Shower Pool Beach Bathroom Super Absorbent,Soft,Quick Dry,Lightweight,Plush
features: The package contains four striped towels of different colors: purple/white, blue/white, gray/white, purple/white.
Fine workmanship, using edge wrapping technology, beautiful and fixed, not easy to fall off.
The cloth and weaving technology used in the towel make the towel not easy to shed, soft in hand, durable, and has good water absorption.
The fluff is full and fluffy, and it is as soft as air in contact with the skin, and can be used by children and adults.
Instructions for use: Before using for the first time, please wash with warm water. After cleaning, hang it in a ventilated place to dry.
